title: CZ says tokenized Anthropic is coming to BNB Chain on IPO day
summary: Changpeng Zhao says Anthropic-linked tokens from bStocks, Ondo and xStocks will hit BNB Chain on day one of the AI giant’s Nasdaq debut. This follows a $500 million pre-IPO rush that comes with notable fine print.

title: Another U.S. appellate court goes against Kalshi, building the industry's legal headwinds
summary: Despite a Commodity Futures Trading Commission demand that prediction markets return to operating in all 50 states, federal courts continue to get in the way.

title: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is buying its CEO’s venture capital business, Tribe
summary: Sethi, who was appointed co-CEO of Kraken in October 2024, is also the chairman of Tribe Capital.

title: A $1.5 billion crypto startup is taking on Hyperliquid with a Wall Street playbook
summary: Variational and its investors are betting that the future of onchain trading will look more like a traditional brokerage than a crypto exchange.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
summary: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.
